question: Mohiniyattam is associated with which Hindu God?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vishnu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Mohiniyattam is one of the two classical dance forms that originated in Kerala, the other one being Kathakali.</span&g
